{{Quote|The Hutts gave the Evocii some land to keep them quiet. The catch is, they're expected to work for it.|[[Var'soonta]]|<ref name="Lean" />}}
'''Voam''' was a village of the [[Evocii]] [[Species/Legends|species]] near [[Jiguuna]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] operated a work camp out of the village.<ref name="Lean" />

The Evocii [[Morsel]] was an administrator at the camp.<ref name="Lean" /> [[Var'soonta]] ran his business, [[Var'soonta's Many Treasures]], out of the camp, assisted by his helper, [[Imot]].<ref name="Trophy">{{TORcite|type=general|Trophy Hunter|Hutta}}</ref>
